Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The text states: 'Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS; [29, 30]) evaluates a positive body image-related construct—body appreciation defined as a posture of acceptance and protection toward one's own body's features, despite the assumption of a certain degree of body dissatisfaction. It comprises 10 items (e.g., "I respect my body", and "I feel that my body has at least some good qualities") to be rated for frequency of occurrence (Likert-style scale, ranging between 1—"Never" and 5—"Always").' This indicates BAS-2 was used to assess body appreciation.
